study type: Secondary data analysis of two cross-sectional surveys
cohort: Births in Pakistan using data from the Pakistan Demographic and Health Survey (PDHS) of 2012-2013 and 2017-2018
finding: The stillbirth rate in Pakistan increased from 3.98% to 5.75% between 2012 and 2017, with changes in maternal education, wealth status, and mode of delivery being significant contributing factors.
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries were associated with a lower risk of stillbirth compared to other modes of delivery.
